newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee council now to be installed in Jan..
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee council now to be installed in Jan..

text.p: Brazil's new private and public sector coffee council will only be installed in January after a decision to cancel a meeting due to be held today, said a spokeswoman for a deputy involved in setting up the council.

"The Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles only arrived yesterday from a trip and so it was decided there was not enough time to prepare for the meeting," said the spokeswoman for deputy Silas Brasileiro.
"The first meeting will now be held in January but the date has not yet been set," she added.
Dornelles is the president of the new council which is to comprise six members each from the private and public sector and which will in future define Brazil's coffee policy.
However, traders said one other reason for the delay is that not all the ministries on the council have submitted the names of their representatives.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
